sources.title: Minutes of the Birchfield Common Committee, 17 February 2026: item 5, Dogs on the common
passages: The Committee resolved to make no change to the rules on dogs, which may be off the lead across the common.
Members asked for more bins for dog waste at the north entrance.

sources.title: Minutes of the Alder Park Committee, 10 March 2026: item 4, Dogs in the park
passages: The Committee agreed that dogs must be kept on leads in the walled garden from 1 April 2026.
Members noted that dogs may run free on the main field as before.

sources.title: Minutes of the Canal Gardens Committee, 15 April 2026: item 4, Dogs and the towpath
passages: The Committee agreed that dogs must be on leads along the towpath, where cyclists and walkers share a narrow path.
The rule will be reviewed after twelve months.
